items.title: This is the biggest threat to the AI-powered bull market
items.description: Blockbuster earnings growth has helped to power the stock market higher in 2026. In 2027, that engine might stall.

items.title: Apple’s new earnings era begins at a critical time for Big Tech
items.description: A rare Monday earnings report for Apple will give investors a glimpse into how new CEO John Ternus is managing inflated memory prices and a tougher backdrop for consumer spending.

items.title: My wife cried when I found out she had only $80,000 in her 401(k). I have $2.2 million. Am I wrong to be shocked?
items.description: “When I brought up retiring last spring, she said she was ready whenever I was, and I took that to mean we were in good shape.”

items.title: ‘Showy jewelry and fancy cars hold no appeal’: We have a 99% chance of outliving our life savings. Why not spend it all?
items.description: “I’m 68, she’s 74, and we’re both in good health. We married later in life and have no children.”

items.title: My father has Alzheimer’s and his caregiver is using his debit card for DoorDash. Do I intervene?
items.description: “I suspect the live-in caregiver is benefiting from my parent’s generosity.”

items.title: ‘He was heartbroken’: My husband’s kids abandoned him when he was dying. Was he right to leave everything to me?
items.description: “In the end, he left them a few sentimental mementos, some collectibles and old photographs.”

items.title: Grand Theft Callout: ‘GTA 6’ fans are missing work on the game’s release day because they ‘don’t want to wait’ anymore
items.description: After waiting 13 years for this videogame, almost one-fifth of workers plan to take the day off to play ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ when it drops on Nov. 19

items.title: America is doing better than you think. Your algorithm is just hiding it.
items.description: The bottom half of Americans has more than doubled its net worth since 2019. You wouldn’t know it from scrolling social media.

items.title: Who really wins under Trump’s economy? Coastal liberal elites who hate him.
items.description: In other words, not the people Republicans likely intended.

items.title: My abusive ex-husband promised $20,000 for our kids’ education. Now he refuses to pay. Is he legally obligated?
items.description: “Before our divorce, my former mother-in-law entrusted him with $20,000 for each of our daughters to invest on their behalf.”
